searchText: I am having a hard time connecting to my windows 10 full node. My "local" machine is a linux (ubuntu 20.04). Is there an instruction on the web? How do I need to run `geth --http` on the local machine? I have made the ssh tunnel, it's open and listening. Perhaps I am doing this completely wrong. Very much appreciated.
